requirements.originalQuote: Clause 5.1 The bidder must have successfully completed in the last 7 years either (a) three (3) similar projects each of value not less than Rs 25 Cr, or (b) similar projects satisfying the 80/50/40 rule: one project of at least 80%, or two projects of at least 50% each, or three projects of at least 40% each, of the estimated contract value. Similar projects means Smart City or Highway infrastructure projects.
